title: Elephant Song | Kids Song, Nursery Rhymes, Rhymes for Toddlers | BuBu TV - English
description:
Come and play with the big grey elephant in this fun and cheerful nursery rhyme!
Sing along as the elephant splashes, dances, and waves goodbye.
A warm and gentle song that's perfect for little ones aged 2 to 5.

Big grey elephant, come and play
Swing your trunk and walk this way
Hop on, kids, climb up high
Ride the elephant through the sky

Splish and splash in the pond so blue
Elephant bathes and sprays us too
Bananas, sugarcane, munch, munch, munch
Crunchy, munchy, yummy lunch

Big grey elephant, come and play
Swing your trunk and walk this way

Ring the bells around your neck
Ding dong ding, what a fun trek
Dance at the festival, one, two, three
Wave goodbye, see you soon, Elephant, see!

Big grey elephant, come and play
Swing your trunk and walk this way

Wave your trunk and say goodbye
Elephant, elephant, bye bye, bye!
